label: Figure 6.3: Supply curves with different PES values
alt: Four straight-line supply curves: S1 and S2 pass through the origin (PES = 1), S3 starts on the quantity axis (PES below 1) and S4 starts on the price axis (PES above 1).
caption: Any straight-line supply curve through the origin (S<sub>1</sub> and S<sub>2</sub>) has PES = 1 along its whole length, however steep it is. S<sub>3</sub>, which cuts the quantity axis, is inelastic (PES < 1), while S<sub>4</sub>, which cuts the price axis, is elastic (PES > 1).
